source_text: However, absolute risk reductions remain context-dependent; in low-prevalence areas like North America or Europe, modeling estimates suggest preventing fewer than one HIV infection per 1,000 circumcisions over a lifetime, with no equivalent randomized trial data outside high-burden epidemics.
